title: Urban Expansion and Protection Gaps amid Evolving Flood Exposure
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Flood risk is increasing globally as climate change interacts with urban expansion and land-use decisions in flood zones. Using a nationally consistent, high-resolution assessment, this study analyzes how settlement growth, climate change, and flood protection shape the evolution of flood exposure across more than 11,000 municipalities in Germany, revealing exposure dynamics relevant to many advanced economies. The study integrates biannual settlement footprint data from 2016 to 2025 with fluvial, pluvial, and coastal flood hazard data, future climate scenarios, and detailed dike protection maps. The results show that in several regions the growth of settlements in flood zones has outpaced that in safe zones, thus reinforcing rather than reducing exposure. Climate change is projected to increase flood exposure substantially by late century, particularly under high-emissions scenarios, with pluvial flooding being the dominant driver of future exposure growth. The study identifies substantial mismatches between exposure and structural flood protection, with many highly exposed areas lacking engineered defenses. The findings underscore how misalignment between urban development, climate adaptation, and protection investment can drive rising flood risk, with implications for land-use planning and resilience strategies.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化与城市扩张以及洪泛区内的土地利用决策相互作用，全球洪水风险正在上升。本研究利用一项全国范围一致的高分辨率评估，分析了定居点扩张、气候变化和防洪设施如何塑造洪水暴露的演变，涵盖德国11,000多个市镇，揭示了与许多发达经济体相关的暴露动态。本研究整合了2016至2025年的半年度定居点足迹数据、河流、雨洪和沿海洪水灾害数据、未来气候情景以及详细的堤坝防护地图。结果表明，在若干地区，洪泛区内的定居点增长已超过安全区域，从而加剧而非减少了暴露。预计到本世纪末，气候变化将大幅增加洪水暴露，在高排放情景下尤为明显，其中雨洪是未来暴露增长的主要驱动因素。本研究发现，暴露与结构性防洪之间存在显著错配，许多高暴露区域缺乏工程防御设施。研究结果强调，城市发展、气候适应和防护投资之间的错配可能会推动洪水风险上升，这对土地利用规划和韧性战略具有重要启示。

title: Pollution Intensity of Consumption: Exploring the Environmental Engel Curve Based on Micro-Data from 109 Countries
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Environmental Engel curves characterize the relationship between the embodied environmental impact of household consumption choices and their respective income levels. Using detailed microdata from 109 countries across all income levels, this paper studies household expenditure shares on 11 fuel types that differ in their air pollution intensity. The findings show that wealthier households tend to shift away from dirty fuels and toward cleaner ones, although this transition is not guaranteed. In low-income countries, limited infrastructure and poor access to clean fuels slow this process, demonstrating that income alone cannot drive energy transitions. By documenting systematic variation in environmental Engel curves across income groups and national contexts, the paper emphasizes the joint role of income growth and infrastructure development. The analysis also reveals a dual burden of pollution in which richer households are the primary contributors to outdoor air pollution, while poorer households remain reliant on polluting fuels that increase their exposure to indoor air pollution.
abstract_zh: 环境恩格尔曲线刻画了家庭消费选择所隐含的环境影响与其收入水平之间的关系。本文利用109个国家（涵盖所有收入水平）的详细微观数据，研究了家庭在11种空气污染强度不同的燃料类型上的支出份额。研究发现，富裕家庭倾向于从污染性燃料转向清洁燃料，但这一转变并非必然。在低收入国家，有限的基础设施和清洁燃料的可获得性较差，减缓了这一进程，表明仅靠收入无法推动能源转型。通过记录不同收入群体和国家背景下环境恩格尔曲线的系统性差异，本文强调了收入增长与基础设施发展的共同作用。分析还揭示了污染的双重负担：富裕家庭是室外空气污染的主要来源，而贫困家庭则依赖污染性燃料，从而增加了其室内空气污染暴露。

title: Global air pollution exposure and poverty
venue: Nature Communications
abstract: Air pollution is one of the leading causes of health complications and mortality worldwide, especially affecting lower-income groups, who tend to be more exposed and vulnerable. This study documents the relationship between ambient air pollution exposure and poverty in 211 countries and territories. Using the World Health Organization’s (WHO) 2021 revised fine particulate matter (PM2.5) thresholds, we show that globally, 7.3 billion people are directly exposed to unsafe average annual PM2.5 concentrations, 80 percent of whom live in low- and middle-income countries. Moreover, 716 million of the world’s lowest income people (living on less than $1.90 per day) live in areas with unsafe levels of air pollution, especially in Sub-Saharan Africa. Air pollution levels are particularly high in lower-middle-income countries, where economies tend to rely more heavily on polluting industries and technologies. These findings are based on high-resolution air pollution and population maps with global coverage, as well as subnational poverty estimates based on harmonized household surveys.
abstract_zh: 空气污染是全球健康并发症和死亡的主要原因之一，尤其影响低收入群体，他们往往暴露程度更高且更为脆弱。本研究记录了211个国家和地区的环境空气污染暴露与贫困之间的关系。采用世界卫生组织（WHO）2021年修订的细颗粒物（PM2.5）阈值，我们发现，全球有73亿人直接暴露于不安全的年平均PM2.5浓度之下，其中80%生活在中低收入国家。此外，全球最贫穷的7.16亿人（日均收入不足1.90美元）生活在空气污染水平不安全的地区，尤其集中在撒哈拉以南非洲。空气污染水平在中低收入国家尤为严重，这些国家的经济往往更依赖污染性工业和技术。这些发现基于具有全球覆盖范围的高分辨率空气污染与人口地图，以及基于统一家庭调查的次国家级贫困估计。

title: Global evidence of rapid urban growth in flood zones since 1985
venue: Nature
abstract: As countries urbanize, human settlements are rapidly expanding into hazardous flood zones. This study provides a global analysis of spatial urbanization patterns and the evolution of flood exposure between 1985 and 2015. Using high-resolution annual data, it shows that settlements across the world grew by 85 percent to over 1.28 million square kilometers. In the same period, settlements exposed to the highest flood hazard level increased by 122 percent. In many regions, risky growth is outpacing safe growth, particularly in East Asia, where high risk settlements have expanded 60 percent faster than safe ones. Developing countries are driving the recent growth of flood exposure: 82 percent of the 36,500 square kilometers of settlements built in the world’s highest-risk zones since 1985 are in low- and middle-income countries. In comparison, recent growth in high-income countries has been relatively slow and safe. These results document a divergence in countries’ exposure to flood hazards. Rather than adapting their exposure to climatic hazards, many countries are actively increasing their exposure.
abstract_zh: 随着各国城市化，人类居住区正迅速扩张到危险的洪泛区。本研究对1985至2015年间全球城市化空间格局及洪水暴露的演变进行了全球分析。利用高分辨率年度数据，研究表明，全球居住区增长了85%，达到超过128万平方公里。同一时期，暴露于最高洪水灾害等级的居住区增长了122%。在许多地区，危险增长的速度超过了安全增长，特别是在东亚，高风险居住区的扩张速度比安全居住区快60%。发展中国家正在推动近期洪水暴露的增长：自1985年以来，全球在最高风险区域新建的3.65万平方公里居住区中，82%位于中低收入国家。相比之下，高收入国家的近期增长相对缓慢且较为安全。这些结果表明，各国在洪水灾害暴露方面出现了分化。许多国家并未使其暴露程度适应气候灾害，反而正在积极增加这种暴露。

title: Distributional and Health Co-Benefits of Fossil Fuel Subsidy Reforms — Evidence from 35 Countries
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Governments around the world continue to subsidize fossil fuel use, incentivizing unsustainable consumption levels with consequences for the global climate and human health. However, governments have proven reluctant to reform fossil fuel subsidies (FFS). This is mainly due to concerns over potential adverse effects on poverty and equity; the positive effects on air quality and health are often overlooked. This study offers new insights on the distributional consumption incidence of FFS reforms and expected benefits through improved air quality and health outcomes. Using the World Bank-International Monetary Fund Climate Policy Assessment Tool, we conduct country-level analyses of a complete removal of domestic FFS, considering 19 countries for the distributional consumption analysis, and 25 countries for the health benefits analysis. Our findings suggest that across countries, the absolute consumption burden of FFS reform on the richest decile would be 13 times larger than on the lowest-income decile, supporting evidence that FFS are an extremely inefficient way of supporting lower-income groups. In relative terms, however, the disparity is much smaller, with the richest decile bearing a relative consumption burden that is just 1.1 times larger than that borne by the lowest-income decile. In terms of positive health effects, removing FFS in 25 countries could save a total of 360,000 lives by 2035. The magnitude of the health effect depends on country-specific factors, such as the size of initial subsidy programs, and the extent to which these cover the most polluting fuels. FFS reforms can be a first step in improving air quality and reducing the burden of disease associated with air pollution.
abstract_zh: 世界各国政府仍在继续补贴化石燃料使用，助长了不可持续的消费水平，对全球气候和人类健康造成了后果。然而，政府一直不愿改革化石燃料补贴（FFS）。这主要是出于对其可能对贫困和公平产生不利影响的担忧，而对空气质量和健康的积极效应则常被忽视。本研究就FFS改革的消费分配效应以及通过改善空气质量和健康结果所带来的预期收益提供了新的见解。利用世界银行-国际货币基金组织气候政策评估工具，我们对完全取消国内FFS进行了国别分析，其中19个国家用于消费分配分析，25个国家用于健康收益分析。我们的研究发现，在各国范围内，FFS改革对最富有十分位群体的绝对消费负担是最低收入十分位群体的13倍，这支持了FFS是支持低收入群体的极其低效方式这一证据。然而，从相对角度看，差异要小得多：最富有十分位群体承担的相对消费负担仅为最低收入十分位群体的1.1倍。就积极的健康效应而言，到2035年，在25个国家取消FFS可挽救总计36万人的生命。健康效应的大小取决于国家特定因素，例如初始补贴计划的规模，以及这些计划覆盖最具污染性燃料的程度。FFS改革可以作为改善空气质量和减轻空气污染所致疾病负担的第一步。

title: Fossil Fuel Prices and Air Pollution: Evidence from a Panel of 133 Countries
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Fossil fuel combustion is a major contributor to urban air pollution, which in turn can lead to negative health outcomes. While the relationship between fuel prices and consumption has been extensively documented, the knock-on impact on air quality is less studied. Detailed knowledge on the price-pollution channel is valuable in designing effective pollution reduction measures. This paper analyzes the impact of gasoline, diesel, and coal prices on air pollution in 133 countries over a 19-year period. The dataset combines prices, consumption, country-specific variables, and annual average fine particulate matter concentrations in each country’s capital city. Using the common correlated effects estimator, the analysis finds a robust negative relationship between gasoline and diesel prices and particle concentrations. A US$1 increase in the average annual retail price of these common transport fuels is associated with at least a 22.2 microgram per cubic meter decrease in annual average fine particulate matter concentrations. In contrast, there is no significant effect for coal, which is often used in power generation and industrial applications, making it less responsive to short-term price variations. Overall, the results are in line with earlier studies, as price increases are correlated with improved urban air quality for transport fuels.
abstract_zh: 化石燃料燃烧是城市空气污染的主要来源，进而可能导致不良健康后果。尽管燃料价格与消费之间的关系已得到广泛记录，但其对空气质量的连锁影响却较少受到研究。详细了解价格与污染之间的渠道，对于设计有效的污染减少措施具有重要价值。本文分析了133个国家19年间汽油、柴油和煤炭价格对空气污染的影响。该数据集整合了价格、消费、国别变量，以及各国首都城市的年平均细颗粒物浓度。采用共同相关效应估计量，分析发现汽油和柴油价格与颗粒物浓度之间存在稳健的负相关关系。这些常见交通燃料的年平均零售价格每增加1美元，其年平均细颗粒物浓度至少会降低22.2微克每立方米。相比之下，煤炭则没有显著影响，煤炭常用于发电和工业应用，因而对短期价格波动的反应较弱。总体而言，研究结果与早期研究一致：交通燃料价格上涨与城市空气质量改善相关。

title: People's Unequal Exposure to Air Pollution: Evidence for the World's Coal-Fired Power Plants
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The world's over 3,800 coal-fired power plants are sources of substantial emissions of toxic air pollutants. This study explores people's unequal exposure to air pollution from these coal plants. It simulates the wind dispersion of pollutants originating from each coal power plant using the Hybrid Single Particle Lagrangian Integrated Trajectory Model (HYSPLIT) with Gaussian dispersion. The study generates three-dimensional pollution trajectories and provide a global map of nitrogen oxide (NOx), sulfur dioxide (SO2), and particle pollution from coal plants and their contributions to overall pollution levels. The study estimates that 2.3 billion people globally are exposed to SO2 and particle pollution from coal plants; 247.5 million of them are exposed to transboundary pollution from foreign coal plants. The findings show that pollution increases with income levels, though at a diminishing rate at high income levels. In the proximity of coal power plants, downwind areas are associated with higher pollution and lower income levels compared to areas upwind. These findings are consistent with strategic location choices that cause or reinforce environmental injustices associated with air pollution.
abstract_zh: 全球3,800多座燃煤电厂是有毒空气污染物的重要排放源。本研究探讨了人们因这些燃煤电厂而承受的不平等空气污染暴露。研究利用混合单粒子拉格朗日综合轨迹模型（HYSPLIT）结合高斯扩散，模拟了每座燃煤电厂排放污染物的风力扩散。研究生成了三维污染轨迹，并提供了燃煤电厂产生的氮氧化物（NOx）、二氧化硫（SO2）和颗粒物污染及其对总体污染水平贡献的全球地图。研究估计，全球有23亿人暴露于燃煤电厂排放的SO2和颗粒物污染之中；其中2.475亿人暴露于外国燃煤电厂造成的跨境污染。研究结果显示，污染随收入水平上升而增加，但在高收入水平下增速递减。在燃煤电厂附近，与上风区相比，下风区的污染水平更高，收入水平更低。这些发现与导致或加剧空气污染相关环境不公的战略性选址选择相一致。

title: Flood exposure and poverty in 188 countries
venue: Nature Communications
abstract: Flooding is among the most prevalent natural hazards, with particularly disastrous impacts in poor countries. Presenting the first global estimates of the number of people exposed to high flood risks in interaction with poverty, this study finds that 1.81 billion people (23% of world population) are directly exposed to 1-in-100-year floods. Of these, 1.24 billion are located in South and East Asia, where China (395 million) and India (390 million) account for over one-third of global exposure. Low- and middle-income countries are home to 89% of the world’s flood-exposed people. Of the 170 million facing high flood risk and extreme poverty (living on under $1.90 per day), 44% are in Sub-Saharan Africa. Over 780 million of those living on under $5.50 per day face high flood risk. Using state-of-the-art poverty and flood data, our findings highlight the scale and priority regions for flood mitigation measures to support resilient development.
abstract_zh: 洪水是最普遍的自然灾害之一，在贫穷国家造成的破坏尤其严重。本研究首次给出了在洪水风险与贫困交织影响下高洪水风险暴露人口的全球估计，发现18.1亿人（占世界人口的23%）直接暴露于百年一遇的洪水之中。其中，12.4亿人位于南亚和东亚，中国（3.95亿）和印度（3.90亿）占全球暴露人口的三分之一以上。中低收入国家拥有全球89%的洪水暴露人口。在面临高洪水风险且极端贫困（日均收入不足1.90美元）的1.7亿人中，44%位于撒哈拉以南非洲。日均收入不足5.50美元的人口中，有超过7.8亿人面临高洪水风险。本研究利用最先进的贫困和洪水数据，揭示了洪水减缓措施的规模和优先区域，以支持具有韧性的发展。

title: Illicit Schemes: Fossil Fuel Subsidy Reforms and the Role of Tax Evasion and Smuggling
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study develops a computable general equilibrium model for Nigeria, which accounts for informality, tax evasion, and fuel smuggling. By studying the impact of fuel subsidy reform on consumption, tax incidence, and fiscal efficiency, it shows that the presence of illicit activities substantially strengthens the argument in favour of subsidy reform: First, fuel subsidy reform can shift the tax base to energy goods, which are less prone to tax evasion losses than for instance labour. Second, by reducing price differentials with neighbouring countries, subsidy reform reduces incentives for fuel smuggling. Overall, the results show that considering illicit activities reduces the welfare losses of fuel subsidy reform by at least 40 percent. In addition, fuel subsidy reductions (and by extension energy tax increases) have a strong progressive distributional impact. The findings hold under different revenue redistribution mechanisms, in particular uniform cash transfers and the reduction of pre-existing labour taxes.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个针对尼日利亚的可计算一般均衡模型，该模型考虑了非正规经济、逃税和燃料走私。通过考察燃料补贴改革对消费、税负归宿和财政效率的影响，研究表明，非法活动的存在大大增强了支持补贴改革的论据：第一，燃料补贴改革可以将税基转向能源商品，而能源商品比劳动等其他商品更不易遭受逃税损失。第二，通过缩小与邻国的价格差异，补贴改革降低了燃料走私的动机。总体而言，结果表明，考虑非法活动可使燃料补贴改革的福利损失至少减少40%。此外，燃料补贴的削减（以及由此带来的能源税提高）具有强烈的累进分配效应。研究结果在不同的收入再分配机制下均成立，特别是统一现金转移支付和降低既有劳动税的情形。

title: Mobility and Resilience: A Global Assessment of Flood Impacts on Road Transportation Networks
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study provides the first global evaluation of both direct and indirect flood hazard impacts on road transportation networks. It constructs topological road networks for 2,564 human settlements, representing over 14 million kilometers of urban roads. It assesses their exposure to pluvial and fluvial flood risks under 10 scenarios, corresponding to different flood intensities (1:5 year to 1:1,000 year return periods). Under each scenario, the study analyzes direct infrastructure exposure and assesses the indirect effects of flood-induced mobility disruptions: route failures, travel delays, and travel distance increases. The results document a positive relationship between flood return period and flood impact (both direct and indirect). Compared with direct flood hazard exposure, the indirect impact of floods on mobility is more prominent and heterogeneous. The average share of the road network that is flooded by at least 0.3 meters is 3.64 percent (or 24.84 percent) under the 5-year (or 1,000-year) return period, yet 11.58 percent (or 65.67 percent) of the simulated trips fail in the same scenario. The results enable comparisons of exposure and vulnerability of road networks to flood hazards across countries, allowing the identification and prioritization of urban transport resilience measures.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次对洪水灾害对道路交通网络的直接和间接影响进行了全球评估。它为2,564个人类居住区构建了拓扑道路网络，共计代表超过1,400万公里的城市道路。研究在10种情景下评估了这些道路网络对雨洪和河洪风险的暴露程度，这些情景对应不同的洪水强度（重现期从1年一遇到1000年一遇）。在每种情景下，研究分析了直接的基础设施暴露，并评估了洪水引起的出行中断的间接影响：路线中断、出行延误和出行距离增加。结果表明，洪水重现期与洪水影响（包括直接和间接影响）之间存在正相关关系。与直接洪水灾害暴露相比，洪水对出行的间接影响更为突出且更具异质性。在5年一遇（或1000年一遇）的重现期下，道路网络被至少0.3米深的洪水淹没的平均比例为3.64%（或24.84%），但在同一情景下，有11.58%（或65.67%）的模拟出行会失败。研究结果使得各国之间能够比较道路网络对洪水灾害的暴露和脆弱性，从而识别并优先安排城市交通韧性措施。

title: Where Are All the Jobs? A Machine Learning Approach for High Resolution Urban Employment Prediction in Developing Countries
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper

title: Flood impacts on urban transit and accessibility—A case study of Kinshasa
venue: Transportation Research Part D: Transport and Environment
abstract: Transportation networks underpin socioeconomic development by enabling the movement of goods and people. However, despite their frequency, little is known about how floods disrupt transportation systems in developing country cities. We collect an innovative dual-condition transit feed specification dataset, and combine it with a travel survey and high-resolution flood maps to examine how regular floods in Kinshasa impact transport services, job accessibility, and the associated economic opportunity costs from travel delays. Our results show that flood disruptions cause increases in public transit headways, transit rerouting, decreases in travel speeds, which translate into travel delays and loss of job accessibility. This induces substantial economic costs to local commuters – about $1.2 million daily – and hinders the establishment of an integrated citywide labor market. In addition, we reveal sizeable socio-spatial heterogeneities, with clusters of low-income residents incurring a large share of the travel delays and identify critical network segments that should be prioritized for resilience interventions.
abstract_zh: 交通网络通过促进货物和人员的流动，支撑着社会经济发展。然而，尽管洪水频繁发生，人们对其如何扰乱发展中国家城市的交通系统却知之甚少。我们收集了一个创新的双条件公共交通时刻表数据集，并将其与出行调查和高分辨率洪水地图相结合，考察了金沙萨的常规洪水如何影响交通服务、就业可达性以及出行延误带来的相关经济机会成本。结果表明，洪水干扰导致公共交通发车间隔增加、线路改道以及行驶速度下降，进而转化为出行延误和就业可达性的丧失。这给当地通勤者带来了巨大的经济成本，每日约为120万美元，并阻碍了全市统一劳动力市场的形成。此外，我们发现存在显著的社会空间异质性，低收入居民聚集区承担了大部分出行延误，并识别出应优先实施韧性干预的关键网络路段。

title: Floods and Their Impacts on Firms: Evidence from Tanzania
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study explores how businesses in Tanzania are impacted by floods, and which strategies they use to cope and adapt. These insights are based on firm survey data collected in 2018 using a tailored questionnaire, covering a sample of more than 800 firms. To assess the impact of disasters on businesses, the study considers direct damages and indirect effects through infrastructure systems, supply chains, and workers. While direct on-site damages from flooding can be substantial, they tend to affect a relatively small share of firms. Indirect impacts of floods are more prevalent and sizable. Flood-induced infrastructure disruptions—especially electricity and transport—obstruct the operations of firms even when they are not directly located in flood zones. The effects of such disruptions are further propagated and multiplied along supply chains. The study estimates that supply chain multipliers are responsible for 30 to 50 percent of all flood-related delivery delays. To cope with these impacts, firms apply a variety of strategies. Firms mitigate supply disruptions by adjusting the size and geographical reach of their supply networks, and by adjusting inventory holdings. By investing in costly backup capacity (such as water tanks and electricity generators), firms mitigate the impact of infrastructure disruptions. The study estimates that only 13 percent of firms receive government support in the aftermath of floods.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了坦桑尼亚的企业如何受到洪水影响，以及它们采用哪些应对和适应策略。这些见解基于2018年使用定制问卷收集的企业调查数据，样本涵盖800多家企业。为评估灾害对企业的影响，本研究考虑了直接损失以及通过基础设施系统、供应链和工人产生的间接影响。尽管洪水造成的现场直接损失可能相当严重，但其影响的企业比例相对较小。洪水的间接影响更为普遍，规模也更大。洪水引发的基础设施中断，特别是电力和交通中断，即使对不位于洪泛区的企业也会妨碍其运营。这些中断的影响会沿供应链进一步传播和放大。研究估计，供应链乘数效应造成了30%至50%的洪水相关交付延误。为应对这些影响，企业采取了多种策略。企业通过调整供应网络的规模和地理覆盖范围，以及调整库存持有量，来缓解供应中断。通过投资成本高昂的备用设施（如蓄水罐和发电机），企业减轻了基础设施中断的影响。研究估计，洪灾之后只有13%的企业获得了政府支持。

title: Candle in The Wind? Energy System Resilience to Natural Shocks
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study finds that natural shocks -- storms in particular -- are a significant and often leading cause for power supply disruptions. This finding is based on 20 years of high frequency (i.e. daily) data on power outages and climate variables in 28 countries -- Bangladesh, the United States and 26 European countries. More specifically: (1) Natural shocks are the most important cause of power outages in developed economies. On average, they account for more than 50 of annual outage duration in both the US and Europe. In contrast, natural shocks are responsible for a small share of outages in Bangladesh, where disruptions occur on a daily basis for a variety of reasons. (2) Outages due to natural shocks are found to last significantly longer than those due to non-natural shocks in -- e.g. more than 4.5 times in Europe. Reasons include the challenge of locating wide-spread damages, and the sustained duration of storms. (3) Several factors can reinforce the adverse effect of natural shocks on power supply. In the US, forest cover is shown to significantly increase the risk of power outages when storms occur. (4) There are significant differences in network fragility. For instance, wind speeds above 35 km/h are found to be 12 times more likely to cause an outage in Bangladesh than in the US. This difference may be explained by a range of factors, including investments in infrastructure resilience and maintenance.
abstract_zh: 本研究发现，自然冲击（尤其是风暴）是导致供电中断的重要且往往是首要的原因。这一发现基于28个国家（孟加拉国、美国以及26个欧洲国家）长达20年的高频（即每日）停电数据和气候变量。具体而言：（1）在发达经济体中，自然冲击是停电的最主要原因。平均而言，在美国和欧洲，它们占年度停电时长的50%以上。相比之下，在孟加拉国，自然冲击只占停电的一小部分，那里的供电中断每天都会因各种原因发生。（2）由自然冲击导致的停电持续时间显著长于非自然冲击导致的停电，例如在欧洲长出4.5倍以上。原因包括难以定位大范围的损坏，以及风暴的持续时间较长。（3）有若干因素可能会加强自然冲击对供电的不利影响。在美国，森林覆盖率被证明会显著增加风暴发生时停电的风险。（4）各国电网的脆弱性存在显著差异。例如，风速超过35公里/小时时，在孟加拉国引发停电的可能性是美国的12倍。这一差异可能由多种因素解释，包括基础设施韧性投资和维护水平。

title: Wading Out the Storm: The Role of Poverty in Exposure, Vulnerability and Resilience to Floods in Dar Es Salaam
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Dar es Salaam is frequently affected by severe flooding causing destruction and impeding daily life of its 4.5 million inhabitants. The focus of this paper is on the role of poverty in the impact of floods on households, focusing on both direct (damage to or loss of assets or property) and indirect (losses involving health, infrastructure, labor, and education) impacts using household survey data. Poorer households are more likely to be affected by floods; directly affected households are more likely female-headed and have more insecure tenure arrangements; and indirectly affected households tend to have access to poorer quality infrastructure. Focusing on the floods of April 2018, affected households suffered losses of 23 percent of annual income on average. Surprisingly, poorer households are not over-represented among the households that lost the most - even in relation to their income, possibly because 77 percent of total losses were due to asset losses, with richer households having more valuable assets. Although indirect losses were relatively small, they had significant well-being effects for the affected households. It is estimated that households? losses due to the April 2018 flood reached more than US$100 million, representing between 2-4 percent of the gross domestic product of Dar es Salaam. Furthermore, poorer households were less likely to recover from flood exposure. The report finds that access to finance play an important role in recovery for households.
abstract_zh: 达累斯萨拉姆经常遭受严重洪水，给其450万居民造成破坏并妨碍日常生活。本文关注的是贫困在洪水对家庭影响中的作用，同时考察直接影响（资产或财产的损坏或损失）和间接影响（涉及健康、基础设施、劳动和教育的损失），所用数据为家庭调查数据。较贫困的家庭更有可能受到洪水影响；直接受影响的家庭更可能由女性户主担任，且其土地权属更不稳定；间接受影响的家庭往往使用质量较差的基础设施。以2018年4月的洪水为例，受影响家庭平均遭受了相当于年收入23%的损失。令人意外的是，较贫困的家庭在损失最大的家庭中并未占比过高，即便相对于其收入而言也是如此，这可能是因为总损失的77%来自资产损失，而较富裕的家庭拥有价值更高的资产。尽管间接损失相对较小，但它们对受影响家庭的福祉产生了显著影响。据估计，2018年4月洪水造成的家庭损失超过1亿美元，相当于达累斯萨拉姆GDP的2%至4%。此外，较贫困的家庭从洪水暴露中恢复的可能性较小。报告发现，获得金融服务在家庭恢复中发挥着重要作用。

title: Carbon price efficiency: lock-in and path dependence in urban forms and transport infrastructure
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of carbon or gasoline taxes on commuting-related CO2 emissions in an urban context. To assess the impact of public transport on the efficiency of the tax, the paper investigates two exogenous scenarios using a dynamic urban model (NEDUM-2D) calibrated for the urban area of Paris: (i) a scenario with the current dense public transport infrastructure, and (ii) a scenario without. It is shown that the price elasticity of CO2 emissions is twice as high in the short run if public transport options exist. Reducing commuting-related emissions thus requires lower (and more acceptable) tax levels in the presence of dense public transportation. The emission elasticity also depends on the baseline scenario (especially population and income growth) and increases over time. In the longer run, elasticities are similar in the scenarios with and without public transport, due to larger urban reconfiguration in the latter scenario. This analysis may help calibrate general equilibrium models by providing price elasticities that depend on socio-economic and public transport infrastructure scenarios. If the goal of a carbon or gasoline tax is to change behaviors and reduce energy consumption and CO2 emissions (not to raise revenues), then there is an incentive to increase the price elasticity through complementary policies such as innovation support and infrastructure development.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了碳税或汽油税对与通勤相关的城市CO2排放的影响。为评估公共交通对税收效率的影响，本文利用一个为巴黎城市区域校准的动态城市模型（NEDUM-2D），考察了两种外生情景：（i）现有密集公共交通基础设施的情景，以及（ii）不存在公共交通的情景。结果表明，若存在公共交通选择，短期内二氧化碳排放的价格弹性将高出一倍。因此，在公共交通密集的情况下，减少与通勤相关的排放所需的税率更低，也更容易被接受。排放弹性还取决于基准情景（尤其是人口和收入增长），并且随时间推移而增大。从长期看，有公共交通和无公共交通情景下的弹性相似，这是由于后一情景中城市重构的幅度更大。本分析有助于校准一般均衡模型，因为它提供了依赖社会经济和公共交通基础设施情景的价格弹性。如果碳税或汽油税的目标是改变行为、减少能源消费和二氧化碳排放（而非增加收入），那么就有动机通过创新支持和基础设施发展等配套政策来提高价格弹性。

title: Oil price volatility, economic growth and the hedging role of renewable energy
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper investigates the adverse effects of oil price volatility on economic activity and the extent to which countries can hedge against such effects by using renewable energy. By considering the Realized Volatility of oil prices, rather than following the standard approach of considering oil price shocks in levels, the effects of factor price uncertainty on economic activity are analyzed. Sample countries represent developed and developing, oil importing and exporting and service/industry-based economies (United States, Japan, Germany, South Korea, India, and Malaysia) and thus complement the standard literature's analysis of Western OECD countries. In a vector auto-regressive setting, Granger causality tests, impulse response functions, and variance decompositions show that oil price volatility has more-adverse effects in all sample countries than oil price shocks alone can explain. The paper finds that the sensitivity to oil price volatility varies widely across countries and discusses various factors which may determine the level of sensitivity (such as sectoral composition and the energy mix). This implies that the standard approach of solely considering net oil importer-exporter status is not sufficient. Simulations of volatility shocks in hypothetical energy mixes (with increased renewable shares) illustrate the potential economic benefits resulting from efforts to disconnect the macroeconomy from volatile commodity markets. It is concluded that expanding renewable energy can in principle reduce an economy's vulnerability to oil price volatility, but a country-specific analysis would be necessary to identify concrete policy measures. Overall, the paper provides an additional rationale for reducing exposure and vulnerability to oil price volatility for the sake of economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了石油价格波动对经济活动的不利影响，以及各国利用可再生能源对冲此类影响的程度。研究采用石油价格的已实现波动率，而非标准方法中的石油价格冲击水平值，以分析要素价格不确定性对经济活动的影响。样本国家涵盖发达与发展中经济体、石油进口国与出口国以及以服务业和工业为主的经济体（美国、日本、德国、韩国、印度和马来西亚），从而补充了标准文献对西方OECD国家的分析。在向量自回归框架下，格兰杰因果检验、脉冲响应函数和方差分解表明，石油价格波动在所有样本国家中的不利影响，都超过了仅用石油价格冲击所能解释的程度。研究发现，各国对石油价格波动的敏感性差异很大，并讨论了可能决定敏感性高低的各种因素（如部门构成和能源结构）。这意味着，仅考虑石油净进口国或净出口国地位的标准做法是不够的。对假设能源结构中可再生能源份额增加情景下的波动冲击进行的模拟表明，努力使宏观经济与波动的商品市场脱钩，可带来潜在的经济收益。研究得出结论，扩大可再生能源原则上可以降低一国对石油价格波动的脆弱性，但需要开展针对具体国家的分析，才能确定具体的政策措施。总体而言，本文为降低对石油价格波动的暴露和脆弱性以促进经济增长提供了额外的理由。
